scripts.build:native: pnpm --filter @yadaw/dsp-node build && cargo build -p yadaw-audio-host --release && cmake -S . -B target/vst3-bridge-build -DSMTG_ENABLE_VST3_PLUGIN_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSMTG_ENABLE_VST3_HOSTING_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSMTG_ENABLE_VSTGUI_SUPPORT=OFF && cmake --build target/vst3-bridge-build --config Release --target yadaw-vst3-probe
scripts.check: pnpm check:rust && pnpm -r --if-present check && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-db test:integration
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo test -p yadaw-dsp-node --features bench-internals --test realtime_allocations && cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals --no-run
scripts.bench:rust: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals
scripts.bench:rust:quick: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --quick
scripts.bench:rust:save: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --save-baseline main
scripts.bench:rust:compare: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --baseline main
